(i) the atmospheric circulation in the North Africa region is an important driver of the wintertime Mediterranean rainfall variability and (ii) the uncertainty in the future Mediterranean rainfall projection is dominated by the uncertainty in the circulation response.

the interannual variability of the wintertime Mediterranean region precipitation is well described by the atmospheric circulation over North Africa and that the projected precipitation change under global warming is dominated by the circulation response.

the inter-annual relationship between the North African 850 hPa zonally-averaged zonal wind and Mediterranean precipitation holds under climate change, and that the uncertainty in the Mediterranean precipitation response is largely related to the uncertainty in the circulation response.
